resource_audit.known_parked_defect: Caught interruption during post-commit resource observation may double-count persistence; no such interruption is inferred only when every ledger and command completed without failures.

projection_assumptions: Each neural pilot coordinate is projected to ten session/initialization coordinates; physical and nominal coordinates to five sessions.
The pilot selected epochs are observations, not assumed fixed in new draws; stopping/caps and throughput can vary substantially.

Existing common base evaluation/truth receipts are reusable; new adaptive truth requests depend on future selected-model errors. Parent-inclusive nested work is projected with parents and never added again.

One new complete pooled timing request is required for development, including unchanged pilot coordinates; old pilot timing remains retained. Incremental/cumulative projections therefore add the sunk pilot timing to requested-development totals. Timing coordinate-count scaling is approximate.
Primary commissioned fitting is separate from evaluator/truth/scoring/timing/reporting and all independent replication.
These are workload estimates; no hardware commissioning or favorable-compute claim.
Projected artifact bytes retain the old pilot timing separately; new matrix/driver/report/verification overhead and additional adaptive-truth artifact bytes are not guaranteed by this point estimate.
Reporting/raw verification costs are excluded from producer projections and reported separately from their completed CLI measurements.

utc_monotonic_discrepancies.resource_duration_basis: recorded monotonic wall and process CPU
